facts.business: Mukand Limited is an Indian listed company engaged in steel and heavy engineering businesses.
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions entered by the Company during FY 2025-26 with related parties were in compliance with the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. Material RPTs were approved by members and all RPTs were placed before the Audit Committee for prior approval.
